items.content_text:

A handoff is not a folder full of outputs. It is a transfer of unfinished bets. Write down the assumptions, evidence each one rests on, confidence, owner, expiry, and the test that can break it. Put the unresolved ones in front of the next operator, not buried under the successful run.
